summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.48/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.48 a gallon across Wisconsin as of July 7, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 8¢ lower than a week ago, 42¢ lower than a month ago, and 63¢ higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.34) and the highest in La Crosse ($3.67).
